The OIML-CS has two schemes: A (Issue of OIML certificates... actually scheme A is for certificates issued by issuing authorities) — OIML-CS Scheme A involves issuing authorities issuing OIML Certificates of Conformity based on test reports. Scheme B is for MAA (Mutual Acceptance Arrangement) participation. For NMi Certin issuing an OIML Certificate of Conformity, this is Scheme A. Hmm, actually let me think. The OIML-CS came into effect in 2016. Before that, OIML certificates were just "OIML Certificates of Conformity" under the old system. Certificates issued under OIML-CS Scheme A are "OIML Certificates of Conformity" issued by issuing authorities to applicants, based on test reports by testing authorities.
